name: Computer Setup
author: ClipBridge
summary: Install the ClipBridge agent on your computer and check it's running.
description: The agent lets your phone set the computer's clipboard directly (any text, images, no typing) and fetch it back. Tap Install agent and the dongle opens a terminal on your computer and types the installer for you: it downloads the agent from GitHub, checks it, and sets it to start at login. The status shows whether the agent is running; tap it, or Test, to check it answers.
